Hi Marissa,

As part of our SIG and SOC2 update we're asking vendors for concrete vulnerability management evidence. Can you provide the following for Redwood:

- Current authenticated scan cadence (internal images, infra, containers) and external perimeter scans
- SLAs you commit to for triage and remediation by severity (critical / high / medium)
- Example scan export (recent report) and a sample remediation log for a resolved CVE
- Confirmation you run authenticated scans against images before deploy and SCA on build pipelines

We're hoping to include this packet in the AcmePay vendor review next week. If you can send a short attestation PDF plus the exports, that would be ideal.

Specific ask: evidence that recent high/critical CVEs were triaged and either mitigated or scheduled for remediation with expected fix dates. As background: CVE-2027-1234 (public exploit) is on our radar; please call out if that affects you.

Thanks,
Alice

Hi all — confirming Redwood's operational VM commitments and the current status for the items requested.

Operational commitments (effective):
- Scanning cadence:
  • Authenticated host/container scans: weekly (scheduled windows, rolling across clusters).
  • CI image scanning: on every PR/merge using SCA + image vuln scanning (blocked on policy for critical/high).
  • External perimeter scans: monthly (authenticated where applicable) + weekly DAST spot checks of public endpoints.
  • SCA and dependency scanning: continuous during builds.

- Triage & remediation SLAs (standardized):
  • Critical (public exploit or CVSS >= 9): initial triage within 4 hours; mitigation plan within 72 hours; emergency rollback/hotfix outside maintenance window where required.
  • High (CVSS 7–8.9): investigation within 24 hours; mitigation within 7 calendar days.
  • Medium (CVSS 4–6.9): mitigation within 30 calendar days.
  • Low: tracked in backlog; regular patch windows.

CVE-2027-1234 status:
- 2027-05-11 08:16 UTC: flagged by CI image-scan on a developer image.
- 2027-05-11 12:40 UTC: confirmed exploitability context — not present in prod-facing runners; affected images isolated.
- 2027-05-12 03:20 UTC: patch PR created and scheduled for rollout in 2027-05-14 maintenance window; expected completion 2027-05-14 23:00 UTC.

Attachments included in this thread: cve_remediation_log_20270512.csv (export of remediation entries), and I've uploaded the signed attestation draft to Drive for Evelyn to finalize: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq-example-Redwood-Acme-VM-evidence

Notes/operational caveats:
- For customer-impacting remediation requiring coordinated downtime we will propose a maintenance window; otherwise we use hotfix rollouts.
- Our SLA clock starts on detection/triage timestamp recorded in the remediation system.

Marissa/Evelyn — once the attestation is signed I will add the final remediation proof lines to the log and we can send the packet to AcmePay.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
